spec.why: Correct the false platform limitation and add local Copilot CLI lifecycle wiring with explicit cloud boundaries.

requirements.text: Project Copilot installation emits version 1 .github/hooks/wukong.json with direct event arrays, cross-platform command fields, and a 60-second timeout.
A bounded local adapter returns top-level sessionStart context; prompt callbacks reconnect without claiming discarded stdout reaches the model.
Upgrade and removal preserve foreign files, event entries, and settings; malformed owned hook configuration refuses modification.
Copilot limitations describe Wukong installed scope; cloud bootstrap and native execution claims require their own evidence.
Existing host wiring and owner authority remain intact; repository gates and wiki health pass.

out_of_scope: Native CLI activation and cloud job acceptance

decisions.decision: Implement project-scoped local Copilot CLI sessionStart context and userPromptSubmitted reconnection; defer cloud bootstrap and native host acceptance.
decisions.because: The documented prompt command output is discarded; local service reuse is bounded and cloud sandbox deployment is separate. See design.md for alternatives.

decisions.decision: Add an additive copilot-hooks wiring kind and dedicated wrapper, with exact ownership handling for .github/hooks/wukong.json.
decisions.because: Copilot direct arrays and top-level context differ from current host formats; preserve foreign entries and existing integrations. See design.md for alternatives.

designs.title: Local Copilot protocol adapter
designs.detail: Bounded stdin, sessionStart top-level additionalContext, prompt side effects without context claims, no prompt persistence. See design.md.

designs.title: Managed project JSON hooks
designs.detail: Version 1 hook arrays with Unix and Windows commands; dry-run, preflight refusal, runtime pointer, exact ownership upgrade and removal. See design.md.

designs.title: Scoped delivery verification
designs.detail: Temporary installer witness, current docs, repository gates, wiki maintenance and independent review with explicit native/cloud limits.

verify.expect: Documented protocol child-process fixtures pass with exact output shapes, bounded failures, and no prompt persistence.
